title: LoopVLA: Learning Sufficiency in Recurrent Refinement for Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.09948v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models typically treat the deepest representation of a vision-language backbone as universally optimal for action prediction. However, robotic manipulation is composed of many frequent closed-loop spatial adjustments, for which excessive abstraction may waste computation and weaken low-level geometric cues essential for precise control. Existing early-exit strategies attempt to reduce computation by stopping at predefined layers or applying heuristic rules such as action consistency, but they do not directly answer when a representation is actually sufficient for action. In this paper, we present LoopVLA, a recurrent VLA architecture that jointly learns representation refinement, action prediction, and sufficiency estimation. translated_title: LoopVLA：在视觉-语言-动作模型的循环精化中学习充分性
translated_abstract: 当前的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通常将视觉-语言骨干网络的最深层表示视为动作预测的普遍最优选择。然而，机器人操作由许多频繁的闭环空间调整组成，过度的抽象可能浪费计算资源，并削弱精确控制所需的关键低层几何线索。现有的早期退出策略试图通过停在预定义层或应用诸如动作一致性等启发式规则来减少计算，但它们并未直接回答表示何时对动作而言真正充分。在本文中，我们提出了LoopVLA，一种循环VLA架构，它联合学习表示精化、动作预测和充分性估计。LoopVLA迭代地应用一个共享的Transformer块来精化多模态标记，并在每次迭代中产生一个候选动作和一个充分性分数，该分数估计表示是否足够用于动作生成。
tldr: 本文提出LoopVLA，一种循环VLA架构，通过联合学习表示精化、动作预测和充分性估计，动态判断何时表示足够进行动作，从而在保持精确控制的同时减少计算浪费。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes LoopVLA, a recurrent VLA architecture that jointly learns representation refinement, action prediction, and sufficiency estimation to dynamically determine when a representation is sufficient for action, reducing computation waste while maintaining precise control.
